description: Agent runs, newest first: `status` active (queued, running), finished, or a comma list; `agent` whose runs, or which kind of work. Each run says its kind of work (`run_type`, `run_type_name`: Engineering, Testing…) when the server knows it.

agent.description: an agent's id, name or role key (list_agents), or a kind of work by its key (engineer, creative, qa…): in a one-assistant workspace the assistant does every run, so the key finds that kind among the newest runs

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

name: list_runs
title: List runs
